newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Macquarie says starts 2nd half well.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Macquarie says starts 2nd half well.

text.p: Investment bank Macquarie Bank Ltd said on Monday it has started the second half of the year to March 31, 1997, with all businesses performing well.
"We enter the second half of 1996/97 with all businesses performing well and solid transaction flows in the pipeline," managing director Allan Moss said in a statement.
Macquarie earlier reported a 21.3 percent rise in net profit to A$46.03 million in the six months ended September 30, 1996.
Moss said he remained confident the bank would maintain or improve its position in its Australian and overseas markets in the year ahead.
"We continue to be mindful that the markets in which we operate are volatile and that there are many external influences that we cannot predict that can influence our performance," Moss said.
At 10.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), Macquarie shares were steady at A$8.66 on light volume.
